# Mr Meat & Co
> Sydney's Premier Craft Butcher & Grass-Fed Beef Direct to Door

Mr Meat & Co is Sydney's artisanal craft butcher delivering 100% Australian grass-fed beef, premium beef mince, free-range poultry, grass-fed lamb, and custom butcher freezer boxes directly to your door with temperature-controlled cold-chain express delivery.

## Contact & Business Info
- Legal entity: Mr Meat & Co — ABN 71 635 847 908 (verify at https://abr.business.gov.au/ABN/View?abn=71635847908)
- Email: [orders@mrmeatandco.com.au](mailto:orders@mrmeatandco.com.au)
- WhatsApp: [+61400000000](https://wa.me/61400000000)
- Headquarters: Sydney, NSW, Australia
- Minimum Order: $300 AUD
- Free Shipping: Free refrigerated delivery on all orders ($300 min) across Sydney Metro
- Payment Methods: PayID, Direct Bank Transfer, Bitcoin (BTC), Tether (USDT)
- Crypto Discount: Instant 10% discount when paying with cryptocurrency (BTC, USDT). PayID and bank transfer accepted with no surcharge but no discount.

## Product Categories
- [Beef](https://mrmeatandco.com.au/shop/beef/): Australian beef cuts, dry-aged steaks, fresh beef mince, slow-cook roasts, and offal.
- [Chicken](https://mrmeatandco.com.au/shop/chicken/): Australian chicken breasts, thighs, drumsticks, wings, whole birds, lean mince, and crumbed schnitzels.
- [Lamb](https://mrmeatandco.com.au/shop/lamb/): Australian lamb cutlets, loin chops, leg roasts, shoulder, shanks, and mince.
- [Pork](https://mrmeatandco.com.au/shop/pork/): Australian pork cuts, crispy pork belly, ribs, pork shoulder roasts, cutlets, mince, bacon, and ham.
- [Sausages](https://mrmeatandco.com.au/shop/sausages/): Australian craft sausages made with beef, pork, chicken, lamb, and gourmet flavour blends.
- [BBQ & Grill](https://mrmeatandco.com.au/shop/bbq-grill/): Barbecue essentials — steak packs, sausage packs, ribs, skewers, and burger patties.
- [Meat Boxes](https://mrmeatandco.com.au/shop/meat-boxes/): Household meat boxes, value freezer stockers, BBQ boxes, premium steak bundles, and lean protein prep.
- [Ready to Cook](https://mrmeatandco.com.au/shop/ready-to-cook/): Chef-prepared weeknight dinners — chicken schnitzels, crumbed steak, marinated cuts, kebabs, and burger patties.
- [Specialty Meat](https://mrmeatandco.com.au/shop/specialty-meat/): Specialty cuts including veal, goat, wild kangaroo, and game.
- [Seafood](https://mrmeatandco.com.au/shop/seafood/): Fish fillets and portions, raw and cooked prawns, and salmon portions.
- [Pet Food](https://mrmeatandco.com.au/shop/pet-food/): Natural raw BARF pet food — pet mince, beef marrow bones, and chicken frames.
